scope: Read-only review of repeat-safe nonce path and exact timestamp delta only; no repository writes or global coverage credit

findings.detail: The repeat fixture reads and copies shared junit.xml after the second command, then records that hash in a receipt carrying the first command window. It preserves the first outcome correctly, but the first receipt JUnit bytes describe the second invocation.
findings.requiredAction: Capture firstJUnit bytes/hash before the second command; retain separate first/second JUnit bytes and receipt association, or explicitly label the fixture receipt as spanning both commands.

limits: No independent rerun of already passing tests.
Producer foundation still requires downstream admission to verify threshold-only failure and full raw/global provenance.
